lines.text: My first night in the new room. The blanket smells like you now, and that is my favorite smell.
I sniffed every corner of the room today. The corner with the bowl is the best corner.
You said my name about a hundred times today. {name}. I think it suits me.
I hid behind the toy basket for a while today, then I came out for the squeaky ball.
I carried the squeaky ball to you four times today. You threw it every time. Best game ever.
The rope tug and I had a serious match this afternoon. I won, mostly.
We walked past a park full of pigeons today. I bounced the whole way home.
I found a pinecone on our walk and played with it until it rolled under the couch.
I napped in the sunny spot by the window for most of the afternoon. Ten out of ten.
Our walk was lovely, and the nap on the rug after it was even lovelier.
Rainy day. I stayed curled up on the blanket and listened to the drops on the window.
I tried to sit in training today, but lying down felt more like me. Tomorrow, sit.
There was a new smell by the lamppost on our walk. I need to investigate again tomorrow.
I watched a snail cross the path today. It took forever. I loved every second.
The diary shelf is very interesting. I sniffed it until you laughed.
The brush came out today and I sighed like the world was ending. Then I looked very shiny.
A leaf landed on my nose on our walk. I told the whole street about it.
I flopped onto my back in the hallway so you would rub my belly. It worked.
Dinner was taking too long, so I made my loudest little noise next to the bowl. Worth it.
I fell asleep on your feet tonight. They are warm and they are mine.
We sat together by the window and watched the rain. The best kind of evening.
After the brushing I leaned on you for a long time. My fur felt so soft.
Dinner was in the bowl at exactly the right time. I licked the bowl clean to say thank you.
I learned that the treat jar makes a special sound. I will be listening for it forever.
Kibble crunch, then a walk, then more kibble crunch. A perfect day.
I barked at a big umbrella on our walk today. It did not bark back. I win.
We crossed the little bridge by the pond and I did not look down once.
A bus rumbled past on our walk and I stood very tall. Then I wagged at it.
A friendly dog said hello on our walk. I said hello back from behind your legs.
I peeked out from the blanket when you came home. Then I came all the way out.
The new toy squeaked and surprised me. I watched it from across the room until it was my friend.
My teeth feel funny today. The chew toy helps, and so does your hand on my head.
I chewed the chew toy and only the chew toy. Okay, and a tiny corner of the rug.
Teething day. I gnawed on the chew toy while you read. We were both very busy.
My new teeth are coming in. I tried them out on the rope tug and they work great.
We went to the vet today. I sat on the table like a big pup and they called me a good pup.
The vet had a room full of new smells. I sniffed all of them and got a biscuit at the end.
The vet's table was cold, but you held me the whole time. Now I have my own booklet.
Vet day. I made a big fuss at the door, then forgot all about it when I saw the biscuit tin.
We walked so far today that I got the zoomies. Three laps of the room and one of the couch.
Zoomies after our big walk. You chased me and I let you almost catch me.
I ran circles around the toy basket tonight. I do not know why. It felt amazing.
Big walk, big zoomies, big nap on the blanket. In that order.
I found your sock under the bed. It is my sock now. We played tug and I let you win it back.
I guarded a sock in my bed very seriously. You traded me the rope tug for it. Fair deal.
The sock smelled like you, so I kept it in my bed. You found it and laughed.
I stole a striped sock and ran a victory lap down the hallway. Best sock yet.
A few too many treats today, and my tummy got grumbly. A slow, quiet evening put it right.
My tummy was wobbly, so we skipped the treat jar and napped together. Much better now.
Plain kibble and a long nap today. My tummy is back to normal and I feel bouncy again.
Short walk today, long cuddle tonight. I liked both.
We stayed in and I chewed the rope tug while it rained. A cozy kind of day.
Quiet day. I watched the birds from the windowsill while you read. That was nice.
This was a slow, cozy week. I got extra blanket time and so many ear scratches.
We took the short way around the block today. I sniffed every single fence post.
We played tug in the hallway today instead of a long walk. I won twice.
Training today. I almost sat. My back half sat, anyway.
I learned that sitting makes treats appear. I am a genius.
Sit practice again. I got it right twice and you clapped.
I sat. On purpose. You made the happiest sound.
We are resting this week. I found the softest spot on the blanket and I am keeping it.
Rest days are good days. I watched the rain and kept your slippers warm.
Quiet week, slow mornings, extra naps by the window. I like resting with you.
I looked in the hallway mirror today and I think my legs got longer.
Two weeks together. My ears finally fit my head, mostly.
I can reach the couch cushion now without jumping twice. Big pup things.
We walked all the way to the bakery and back. It smelled like warm bread the whole time.
Long walk in the rain today. I shook off on the doormat and you laughed.
We found a new path by the river. I want to go back and smell it again.
Morning walk, crunchy leaves, then breakfast in my bowl. Perfect order.
{name} is a good name for a pup who carries a plush duck everywhere. That is me.
I hid under the bed when the vacuum came out. You sat on the floor with me until it was quiet.
